script.base: Market prices a near-coin-flip: HOME -2 implies about 24.25-22.25 in a 46.5 game, so neither side is scripted for a blowout. Base flow is HOME leaning on PLY13 (58 carries, 298 rush yards, 5.1 YPC over L3) against AWAY's 5.29 YPC run defense, with AWAY throwing enough to stay in it but not freely — HOME blitzes 38% and AWAY's QB is -0.01 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=81) versus +0.16 unblitzed, so AWAY's deep tree (PLY02 265 air, PLY10 262 air) is the part that stalls and the short tree stays alive.
script.flip1: HOME leads by two scores and clocks it. PLY13 carry share holds or rises and the rush-yard over is safer; AWAY abandons its already-inefficient run (PLY07 28 carries for 64 yards, 2.3 YPC) and PLY07's receiving work becomes the path, while PLY02/PLY10 deep yards die into the blitz.
script.flip2: AWAY jumps ahead or it turns into a shootout. HOME pass rate rises, PLY13 carries fall toward the low teens, and the rush-yard number is the leg that breaks; AWAY can stay on scheduled deep shots to PLY02/PLY10 and PLY07's checkdown volume is the piece that shrinks.

injury_fallout: No injury report, practice trend, questionable tags, or inactives in the pack, so nobody is named as a next-man-up from an absence and this read is pre-inactives only. On-field usage already shows the roles: HOME rush is PLY13 58 of the charted L3 carries (PLY08 10/29, PLY06 5/10, X14 2/7); AWAY rush is PLY07 28/64 plus a more efficient X02 16/75, with PLY05 only 3/6. Passing-down absorbent on AWAY is already PLY07 (20 targets, 55 air) behind PLY02 and PLY10. Props with no L3 role in the pack — PLY11, PLY14, PLY12, PLY03 — are not edges. A late scratch of PLY13 or PLY07 would void both legs; that checkpoint is not here.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. AWAY allows 7.44 left (91), 8.24 middle (41), 7.79 right (90) — soft on every landmark, middle worst.
matchup.pressure: HOME blitz rate 38% is the pressure edge. AWAY QB EPA/dropback is -0.01 vs blitz (n=81) and +0.16 with no blitz, so pressure that arrives should cut deep WR yards and lift short throws. AWAY blitzes only 27%; HOME QB stays positive vs blitz (+0.07, n=65) versus +0.11 unblitzed, so HOME is not under the same stress.
matchup.bleeds: AWAY run defense is the clear bleed: 5.29 YPC and 27 runs of 10+ over 7 games, versus HOME's 4.32 YPC and 22 runs of 10+. Explosive pass rate is similar and not a lockdown for either side (HOME 17 of 232 att at 20+, AWAY 19 of 239). No yards-allowed-by-position or YAC splits in the pack.
matchup.overlap: Primary overlap is PLY13's carry role (58/298 L3, about 19 carries and 99 rush yards a game) running into AWAY's 5.29 YPC defense — the offense's top option attacks the defense's weakest stat. Second overlap is PLY07's short target profile (20 targets, 55 air yards, 147 rec yards) into HOME's 38% blitz, not PLY02/PLY10's 10-plus aDOT into that same blitz.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY13 is the carry-share back running at the softest run defense in the pack — AWAY allows 5.29 YPC and 27 gains of 10+ over 7 games — and a HOME -2 script should keep that role on the field rather than in a pass-only chase; L3 production of 99 rush yards a game is the sizing, not the reason.
edge_players.must_be_true: PLY13 keeps something near the L3 share (58 carries / 3 games, 5.1 YPC), is active with no snap cap, and HOME is not forced into a full chase. Script-dependent: it needs the base script or the HOME-ahead flip, not the AWAY-leads flip.
edge_players.kills_it: HOME trails early, carry count drops to about 14, and YPC regresses to 4.0 — that is roughly 56 yards and a loss at 80.5. Also killed by a PLY13 inactive or by PLY08/PLY06 stealing the down-and-distance work.

edge_players.edge_sentence: HOME's 38% blitz meets an AWAY QB who is flat vs pressure (-0.01 EPA/dropback on 81 blitzed dropbacks vs +0.16 clean), which is the setup that feeds the short option; PLY07 is already that option (20 targets, 55 air yards, 147 rec yards over L3), so 27.5 is a low rung on a role the blitz should protect rather than a bet on a deep shot.
edge_players.must_be_true: PLY07 keeps passing-down snaps and about 5-plus targets, and HOME actually brings the 38% blitz instead of sitting in coverage and letting PLY02/PLY10 hunt. Health and no snap limit — neither is in the pack.
edge_players.kills_it: AWAY leads and stays on the ground, or HOME plays soft and the ball stays with PLY02 (265 air) and PLY10 (262 air). Three or four targets at his 7.4 yards per target lands on or under 27.5. A PLY07 inactive kills it outright.

market_rung_price: PLY13 rushyds over 80.5 -114 — carry share plus a weak run defense in a mild positive script, main line not a short alt. rushrecyds over 100.5 -113.5 would survive a trailing flip better (L3 rush+rec about 118) but is not the chosen market. PLY07 recyds over 27.5 -116 — pressure/underneath volume rung, not an explosive-yard alt. No TD, reception, or passing-yard markets.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the -2 was a fake favorite script: AWAY scored first, HOME threw to chase, and PLY13 finished on 13-14 carries in the low 60s while AWAY never needed the checkdown — PLY02 and PLY10 took the explosives and PLY07 sat on 3 targets for about 20 yards. The other way it loses is operational, not schematic: either back was limited or inactive and the pack had no final report to catch it, or AWAY sold out to the box, held PLY13 under 4.0 YPC, and the 19-yard cushion over 80.5 was gone by halftime. That counter-case is real because the spread is only -2, but it is not stronger than the read — 58 carries in three games is a role, and 5.29 YPC allowed is seven games of not stopping the run, not one soft outing.
slip_story: One story only: mild HOME control plus pressure, the favorite-runs-it stack. PLY13 rush yards over is the clock piece; PLY07 rec yards over is the blitz-checkdown piece on the other sideline. They win together if HOME leads or the game stays tight and HOME keeps blitzing. Do not add PLY02 or PLY10 overs (those need the deep tree this blitz is built to kill), do not add a game under, and do not add PLY16/X17-style HOME pass overs that need HOME to throw. Main slip is these two legs, no TDs, one market per player.
